items.title: Woman says she 'closed eyes and tried not to be there' during alleged Russell Brand rape
items.summary: The 51-year-old faces three counts of rape, three charges of sexual assault and one of indecent assault.

items.title: Doomsday cult leader found guilty of murdering 190 children and one adult
items.summary: Doomsday cult leader Paul Mackenzie, his wife Rhoda Maweu, and 29 other co-accused have been found guilty of the murder of 190 children and one adult.

items.title: Companies exploiting welfare system by using residents as 'cash cows', BBC finds
items.summary: Agents try to attract people on housing benefit by using social media videos that offer free rooms and holidays.

items.title: UEFA writes to FIFA demanding answers on Trump-Infantino dealings
items.summary: European football chiefs have sent a list of 42 questions to FIFA, demanding answers about Gianni Infantino's alleged "conflicts of interest" over business dealings with the Trump family…

items.title: Four arrested after police officer injured in shooting
items.summary: The officer was shot in the foot and remains in hospital in a stable condition, police say.

items.title: King 'sends books and letters' to Myanmar's detained ex-leader'
items.summary: Myanmar's detained former leader Aung San Suu Kyi has been photographed receiving books and letters from the King Charles, officials said.
